title: Selected compatible perfect matching
statement: For a tuple of $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set, each of size $k$ and with empty symmetric difference, together with a permutation of the $k$ indices for each part, the selected compatible perfect matching is a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part.
